اشتعلتم (form VIII)
# اِشْتَعَلْتُمْ (ištaʕaltum) /iʃ.ta.ʕal.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِشْتَعَلَ (ištaʕala)
# اُشْتُعِلْتُمْ (uštuʕiltum) /uʃ.tu.ʕil.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِشْتَعَلَ (ištaʕala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
